name: A dedicated point of contact
detail: You will have a clear point of contact throughout the project who understands your requirements, decisions, and progress. You will always know who to speak to when you have a question, need an update, or want to make a decision.

name: Clear pricing by phase
detail: Before each phase begins, you will know what we are delivering, what it will cost, and what assumptions the price is based on. If a change affects the scope, timeline, or cost, we will discuss and agree it with you before carrying out the additional work.

name: You own what we build
detail: The software, designs, documentation, and project deliverables created specifically for you belong to you, subject to the terms agreed in your contract. We will provide the access and documentation you need to operate, maintain, and continue developing your solution.

name: Support beyond delivery
detail: Our involvement does not have to end when the project goes live. We provide a proper handover and can continue supporting, maintaining, improving, and expanding your solution through an ongoing support arrangement when your business needs it.
